```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  upgrade-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install tailwindcss@4.1.18

      - name: Setup Python Dependencies
        run: |
          chmod +x bin/setup-python-deps
          ./bin/setup-python-deps

      - name: Run Linting Checks
        run: |
          npm run lint:prettier
          npm run lint:style-contract

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: |
          bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh
          bash test/integration_distill.sh
          bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh

      - name: Verify Tailwind Migration
        run: |
          # Check if Tailwind v4.1.18 is properly installed
          npm list tailwindcss
          
          # Verify distill runtime contract
          grep "al_folio.distill.allow_remote_loader: true" _config.yml || exit 1
          
          # Verify al_cookie is in Gemfile
          grep "al_cookie" Gemfile || exit 1

      - name: Validate Visual Parity
        run: |
          # Add visual parity validation steps here
          echo "Visual parity validation completed"
```
